langai/01-assessment.webp.title: Apžiūra ir matavimai
langai/01-assessment.webp.text: Tiksliai išmatuojame angą ir aptariame sprendimą

en.title: Survey and measurements
en.text: We measure the opening and agree on the solution

en.title: Preparing the room
en.text: Furniture and floors are covered

en.title: Removing the old units
en.text: The old window comes out carefully

en.title: Preparing the opening
en.text: The opening is cleaned and levelled

en.title: Dry fit
en.text: Sizes are checked before fixing

en.title: Alignment
en.text: Levelled with a spirit level and shims

en.title: Fixing
en.text: Anchored securely to the wall

en.title: Sealing and insulation
en.text: Gaps are filled with installation foam

en.title: Finishing
en.text: Trims and sills are fitted

en.title: Check and handover
en.text: Everything is tested and the room tidied

durys/01-assessment.webp.title: Apžiūra ir matavimai
durys/01-assessment.webp.text: Išmatuojame angą ir aptariame durų modelį

en.title: Survey and measurements
en.text: We measure the opening and agree on the door model

en.title: Preparing the room
en.text: Floors and the hallway are protected

en.title: Removing the old units
en.text: The old door comes out carefully

en.title: Preparing the opening
en.text: The opening and threshold are cleaned

en.title: Dry fit
en.text: Sizes are checked before fixing

en.title: Alignment
en.text: The frame is levelled with a spirit level

en.title: Fixing
en.text: The frame is screwed in place

en.title: Sealing and insulation
en.text: Gaps are filled and the threshold sealed

en.title: Finishing
en.text: Hardware and trims are fitted

en.title: Check and handover
en.text: Locks and seals are tested
